design: Frozen base plus64 features: PCA of2080 products of standardized existing64 reads, or PCA of input projected off existing read span. Means/PCA/scales fit on first768 docs only. Same five ridge/eight KL fits and256 validation docs. Existing H280 linear fit frozen baseline. Equal73728 fitted output coefficients; map storage and complexity differ.

gates.quadratic_gain: KL quadratic vs linear>=5% relative KL reduction, paired97.5% lower>0
gates.outside_gain: KL outside vs linear same criterion
gates.family_difference: abs((outsideKL-quadraticKL)/outsideKL)>=5%, paired97.5% interval excludes0; fixed outside denominator

scope: One feature construction per family and one split; not exhaustive capacity or semantics test.
interval_scope: 97.5% per contrast, not simultaneous familywise intervals; bootstrap conditions on frozen fits
